title: College Graduates in Caps Gowns, Commencement - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing university students walking in an outdoor commencement procession in March 1966. The young men and women wear traditional dark academic regalia, including mortarboards with tassels and flowing gowns, some with collared white hoods. In the background are campus trees and brick collegiate buildings, along with seated spectators and faculty. The margin bears the developer stamp 'MAR • 66'.
